verdict.rationale: Docs confirm data-in (SDKs, Pipelines/Track API) and data-out integrations plus API keys and a Postman collection, and 'use your preferred tools and sources' language implies broad connectivity, but there is no explicit first-party mention of maintained connectors for Stripe, Shopify, or Segment specifically. Missing for 10: named first-party Stripe/Shopify/Segment integration pages or catalog, integration marketplace listing, and independent confirmation these connectors are actively maintained.
